g: coming down ..., wrapped in ...
分词与过去分词短语均修饰 angel。
e: like pillars of fire
like 构成腿部形象的比喻。

g: He had ..., and he set ...
两个过去时动词并列。
e: on the sea ... on the land
平行介词短语定位两只脚。

g: When he called out, ... sounded
when 从句后接主句。
e: like a lion roaring
like 后接名词加分词，构成动态比喻。

g: had sounded, I was about to write
过去完成先发生；be about to 表正要。
e: what ... have said
what 从句作 Seal up 的宾语。

g: whom I saw standing
whom 作 saw 宾语；standing 修饰 angel。
e: raised his right hand to
raise A to B 表向 B 举起 A。

g: who lives ..., who created ...
两个 who 从句修饰 him。
e: there would be no more delay
would be 是过去视角中的未来。

v: 成就；would be fulfilled 为被动。
g: in the days ... to be sounded
to be sounded 为被动不定式，修饰 trumpet call。
e: just as he announced
just as 表“正如”，引出对应方式。

g: the voice that I had heard ... spoke
that 从句修饰 voice；had heard 早于 spoke。
e: Go, take ...
两个并列祈使动词。

g: Take and eat it; it will make ...
make + 宾语 + 形容词。
e: sweet as honey
as + 名词作程度比喻。

g: when I had eaten it
过去完成表先于 was made bitter。
e: sweet ... but ... bitter
but 连接强烈味觉对比。

v: 说预言；勿与 prophecy 名词混淆。
民族；复数 peoples 指不同族群。
g: You must again prophesy about
must 表必然任务；about 后接对象。
e: peoples and nations and languages and kings
四类对象并列，朗读可分组。
